source_title: MEDKids Tongue starter card (demonstration data, unreviewed)
primary_objective: How the tongue helps us taste and speak
educational_content: The tongue is a muscle. Taste buds on the tongue help us taste food. We can taste sweet, salty, sour, bitter and savory. The tongue moves food around when we chew. The tongue helps us talk and make sounds.
learning_objectives: Taste buds on the tongue help us taste food.

forbidden_claims.claim: Each part of the tongue tastes only one flavor
